format_boundary: Review views over existing contracts; not a new runtime schema, global registry, or Canonical Store.

step4_prerequisite.accepted_effect_boundary: Reuse the existing scoped Step4 administrative acceptance; this candidate issues no new acceptance, runtime authority or Freeze.

scope.current_scope: Current repository, present delivery artifacts, and actual current dependencies under the recorded user scope amendment.
scope.target_rule: The 23 original rows remain the sole proposed responsibility/target crosswalk. No new file-by-file target map or FrozenTargetMap is issued here.
scope.history_rule: Preserve source/archive/legacy identifiers and exact bytes. Current references may later point to an explicit compatibility record; historical artifacts are not rewritten.
scope.inactive_domains: Model/commercial/entitlement types remain design references. No SKU, Offer, Entitlement, ModelReleaseUnit or activation instance is created; those inactive futures do not gate this bounded identity preparation.

axes.subject: current repository product/version label
axes.interpretation: The product input v0.2.1 is an upstream design input, not this repository release label.

axes.subject: architecture author candidate
axes.interpretation: Sole direct predecessor is architecture v0.2.4 bound by ReviewSubjectContract; no architecture acceptance is inferred.

axes.subject: stable 23-row target map
axes.interpretation: Map row revision v0.1.1; structure document revision v0.1.4; upstream mapping input v0.4.3 is a separate input identity.

axes.subject: per-schema definition identities
axes.interpretation: Resolve exact schema ID and manifest digest per consumer; schema-only local evidence is not runtime qualification.

axes.subject: existing current author artifact registry entries
axes.interpretation: Artifact logical/revision/domain/type semantics use the original crosswalk; same path alone does not identify bytes.

axes.subject: coexistence design document
axes.interpretation: This is a design document version, not an installed SkillRevision or Kernel version; exact host/role/bytes remain per-projection binding.

axes.subject: actual component or run
axes.interpretation: No new aggregate runtime version is assigned. Step 6 binds applicable component/run/target revisions; existing runtime is not declared absent.

axes.subject: delivered review package
axes.interpretation: Transport candidate revision is identified by exact ZIP digest; inner design identities retain their own axes.

axes.subject: future authorized migration plan/run
axes.interpretation: No migration has run. Revision will be assigned to the actual plan/run at its prescribed step, without editing historical source IDs.

axes.subject: continuity protocol and local manifest
axes.interpretation: Protocol namespace, manifest schema and definition version are separate fields; no product/architecture predecessor inferred.

other_design_versions.rule: Retain all original values without promoting design-document versions to product/runtime/Schema versions.
